name: MR-TF Approach
definition: An interactive method for Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) in Mixed Reality Head-Mounted Displays (MR-HMDs) that uses biometric interfaces for Region of Interest (ROI) selection and optimizes Transfer Function (TF) parameters to match a target visibility, weighted by color contrast with physical backgrounds.
summary: The MR-TF Approach is an interactive Direct Volume Rendering method for Mixed Reality that uses eye-gaze and finger-pointing to automatically optimize Transfer Functions for selected regions.
